schema: frame-local source pixels; rect [x,y,w,h] inclusive; origin = beam start (pixel-centre coords, front edge at the eye centre line); authored facing right

appear0.reason: Appearing stripe-materialise frame: face not yet formed

appear1.reason: Appearing: face still broken into stripes; eye pixels are noise

appear2.reason: Appearing: last materialise frame; face mottled, eyes not reliably formed

hurt0.reason: Hurt recoil: head thrown back into shadow, no eye visible

hurt2.reason: Hurt: eyes squeezed shut (black lid lines); the green pixel found by detection is the wrist gem

def16.reason: Defeated: stripe dissolve begins over the face
